feature.title: Convert all 18 views from pure template functions to controller factories

tasks.title: Create view controller factory pattern template and convert first 6 simple views
tasks.description: Convert the 6 simplest views (no sub-views, no complex state) to controller factories. Each exports `createXView({ router, eventBus })` returning `controller({ template, state, methods })`. State moves from god-controller to view-local state. Methods move from shell.register() to view controller methods. Views: login, compliance, api-keys, audit-log, resources, settings.
acceptanceCriteria: Each file exports `createXView({ router, eventBus })` not `function xView({ state, fn })`
Each factory returns `controller({ template, state, methods })`
State keys (loading, error, data arrays) moved from shell state to view-local state
View-local methods NOT registered on shell; registered via view controller's methods or register()
Template function signature unchanged: `({ state, fn }) => htmlString`
All existing esc() calls preserved
All existing id attributes preserved
No regression: views render identical HTML output

tasks.title: Convert 6 medium-complexity views to controller factories
tasks.description: Convert views with moderate state and sub-interactions: dashboard, calendar-connections, event-types, availability, routing-forms, pools. These have list data, loading states, error states, and create/edit flows.
acceptanceCriteria: Each file exports `createXView({ router, eventBus })`
Each factory returns `controller({ template, state, methods })`
CRUD operations (create, update, delete) are view controller methods
Loading/error state managed locally in view controller
EventBus used for cross-view communication where needed
No direct access to other view controllers' state
All existing esc() calls preserved
No regression in view rendering

tasks.title: Convert 6 complex views to controller factories
tasks.description: Convert the most complex views: booking (multi-step wizard with sessionStorage), booking-page-editor, workspace-detail (3-column with tasks/timer/messages), workspaces (list), webhooks, contacts, contact-detail, time-tracking. These have sub-states, timers, forms, and real-time interactions.
acceptanceCriteria: Each file exports `createXView({ router, eventBus })`
Each factory returns `controller({ template, state, methods })`
Booking wizard: sessionStorage persistence moved to view controller methods
Workspace detail: timer logic uses ctrl.defer() for tick, ctrl.destroy() cleans up
Webhooks: add/edit form state is view-local, not shell state
Contacts: search debounce uses view controller method with 300ms debounce
All XSS onclick fixes applied (esc() on DB-sourced values)
All existing esc() calls preserved
No regression in any view behavior

tasks.title: Add destroy chain to all view controllers and verify lifecycle
tasks.description: Ensure every view controller factory registers cleanup: timeouts via ctrl.defer(), subscriptions via ctrl.unsub(), event listeners via ctrl.trigger(). Verify ctrl.destroy() is called by shell on route change. Add Symbol.dispose support.
acceptanceCriteria: Every view controller's destroy() clears all ctrl.defer() timeouts
Every view controller's destroy() runs all ctrl.unsub() callbacks
Every view controller's destroy() calls unbindAllTriggers (framework auto-handles)
No setTimeout/setInterval outside ctrl.defer()
No addEventListener outside ctrl.trigger()
Symbol.dispose auto-wired (framework handles this)
Memory leak check: create/destroy view 10 times, no growth in window.__app or window.__el
